content.value: A toroidal coil with a ferrite core of 300 turns is used in HF work with small (07) signals. The mean diameter of the toroid is 2.5 cm and the core is 0.5 cm. if the core is Mn-Zn ferrite. What is the approximate inductance of the coil?
